outcome: maternal near-miss events (Severe Acute Maternal Morbidity)
cohort: The study included patients attending the OPD, casualty, and admitted in the Department Of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Yenepoya Medical College Hospital who met the MoHFW maternal near miss identifying criteria.
finding: Hypertensive disorders in pregnancy and hemorrhage were identified as the two leading causes of maternal near-miss events and mortality, followed by sepsis.
